title: Grid Usage
slide_intent: Show how alignment and empty space separate jobs so a reader can find the message, action and image quickly.
strategic_value: The same grid can hold recognizable Instacart elements while allowing different content to lead each communication.
demonstration: The construction grid sits underneath a logo, eyebrow, headline and call to action on the left. A single content frame fills the right side.
practical_value: Group the headline and eyebrow, align the action beneath them and give the image its own block before adding final content.

content_islands.name: Grouping rule
content_islands.spec: Use the left rail to name the four groups and explain the space between them.

content_islands.name: Aligned example
content_islands.spec: Keep the blue grid visible behind the wireframe. Place the logo at the upper left, the text group and outlined action below, and the gray image placeholder opposite.
